response.goal: Build an n8n workflow that triggers on new responses from two Typeform forms, checks the Google Sheet for an existing row with the same email to skip duplicates, adds a new row with name, email, company, form name and timestamp, posts a message to the #sales Slack channel with a link to the row, and emails if any step fails.

plan.step: Configure Typeform triggers in n8n for both demo request forms to capture new submissions via webhooks.
Implement a duplicate check by querying the Google Sheet for an existing row with the same email address to skip duplicate entries.
Add a new row to the Google Sheet containing name, email, company, form name, and timestamp for non-duplicate entries.
Post a short notification message to the #sales Slack channel with a link to the newly created spreadsheet row.
Set up error handling and notification logic to email the team if any step in the workflow fails.

milestones.name: Workflow Implementation and Duplicate Check
milestones.deliverable: Configured Typeform triggers, Google Sheets integration, and email duplicate check logic in self-hosted n8n.

milestones.name: Slack Alerts and Error Handling
milestones.deliverable: Completed Slack notifications with row links and error alerting for failed workflow steps.

risks.risk: Typeform schema changes or missing field mappings between the two different forms.
risks.mitigation: Normalize the payload data structure using an n8n Code node right after the triggers.

risks.risk: Hourly budget model may lead to scope creep if unexpected error handling edge cases arise.
risks.mitigation: Clearly define hourly milestones and provide a capped estimate for the error notification setup.

questions: What email service or node would you prefer to use for the failure notification emails?
Are there specific column headers or sheet structures already established in the target Google Sheet?
assumptions: The client will provide access credentials for their self-hosted n8n instance, Typeform accounts, Google Sheets, and Slack workspace.
The project will be billed on an hourly basis between $25–$40 per hour as stated in the job post.
